DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご用意できました。書類をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: They are ready. Please check the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二か所へ提出するため、二部お願いしました。封筒の中で重なっていて数が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二か所用に二部頼んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. I requested two copies because I need to submit them to two different places. They are overlapping inside the envelope, so I cannot tell how many there are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you requested two copies for two submission destinations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 机の上で一部ずつ分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us separate them on the desk and check each copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚あります。ただ、一つの書類が二枚組なら一部かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 枚数と部数の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are two sheets. However, if one document consists of two sheets, this might be only one copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the difference between the number of sheets and the number of copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の書類は一部一枚です。二部の内容と氏名もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Each copy of this document is one sheet. Please also check the contents and name on both copies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。二部とも自分の名前です。同じ内容でも、提出先ごとに一部ずつ必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名と各提出先への用途を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Both copies have my name. Even though the contents are the same, I need one copy for each destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the name and the intended use for each submission destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのようにお使いください。ご自身の控えが必要なら、提出前に別途ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use them that way. If you need a copy for your own records, please check about that separately before submitting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。一部を控えとして残すと提出用が足りなくなるので、控えの要否は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えは提出用と別に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If I keep one for my records, I will not have enough to submit, so I will check separately whether I need a personal copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check about your personal copy separately from the submission copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お受け取りの部数は二部でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are you receiving two copies, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二部を受け取りました。提出先ごとに分け、机に残していないか確認して持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二部受領と置き忘れの確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have received two copies. I will separate them by destination and check that I have not left anything on the desk before taking them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm receipt of two copies and say that you will check for anything left behind. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。書類はこちらの封筒にお入れください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please put the documents in this envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の検査へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will take you for today's test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前に相談があります。昨日、別の病院でも検査を受けました。同じ検査かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日に別院で検査したが同じか不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before that, I have something to discuss. I also had a test at another hospital yesterday. I do not know whether it was the same test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you had a test at another hospital yesterday but do not know whether it was the same one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日の検査の内容が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have any documents showing what test you had yesterday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 検査名が書かれた明細があります。結果はまだなので、正常だったとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査名の明細があり結果は未判明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an itemized statement listing the test name. I do not have the results yet, so I cannot say they were normal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have an itemized statement with the test name but do not yet know the results. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 明細を診療担当者に見せて、今日の検査との関係を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us show the statement to the clinical staff and check how it relates to today's test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。昨日受けたという理由だけで、今日の検査を自分で取り消さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を見せて自己取消せず関係を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not cancel today's test myself simply because I had one yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the document and check how the tests relate without canceling today's test yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日も必要かどうかは担当者が判断して説明します。ほかの病院の結果を取り寄せたい場合も相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will decide and explain whether today's test is still necessary. Please also ask if you would like to obtain the results from the other hospital.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。検査名と実施日を伝え、結果が出る予定の日も確認しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査日と結果予定日を整理して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will give the test name and date it was performed, and also check when the results are expected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize and communicate the test date and the expected results date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在は確認待ちとして検査担当者へ伝えます。ご案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the testing staff that we are currently waiting for confirmation. Please wait until we call you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。実施済みという事実と未確認の結果を分け、今日の検査をどうするか説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実施歴と結果を区別し今日の扱いを説明してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will distinguish the fact that the test was performed from the results that are not yet confirmed, and listen to the explanation about what to do with today's test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the test history from its results and ask for an explanation of how today's test will be handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 明細をお持ちのままこちらでお待ちください。担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here with your statement. I will check with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その傘は、どちらで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did you find that umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店の入口の傘立てです。閉店後に一本だけ残っていたので、忘れ物と思って持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉店後の傘立てから持ってきたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: In the umbrella stand at the shop entrance. It was the only one left after closing, so I thought someone had forgotten it and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought it from the umbrella stand after the shop closed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店の方には確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you check with someone at the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。いま柄を見ると、店名と「共用」と書いてあります。店の備品かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確認の店舗備品の可能性と共用表示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Looking at the handle now, I can see the shop's name and the words 'for shared use.' It might belong to the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the shared-use label and the unconfirmed possibility that it is shop equipment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つけた場所と、持ってきた経緯を整理しましょう。お客様個人の忘れ物とは断定できませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us clarify where you found it and how you came to bring it here. We cannot conclude that it is a customer's personal lost item, can we?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。店の住所は分かります。道に落ちていたのではなく、傘立てから取ったことを正確に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 道の拾得ではなく傘立てから取った経緯を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. I know the shop's address. I will accurately explain that I took it from the umbrella stand, rather than finding it lying in the street.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you took it from the umbrella stand rather than picking it up in the street. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店舗への確認と、この傘の扱いを担当者に相談します。ご自身で別の傘立てへ置いて帰らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will discuss checking with the shop and handling this umbrella with the staff member. Please do not leave it in another umbrella stand and go home on your own initiative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。確認せずに店へ戻して終わらせず、こちらで説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己返却で終わらせず扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not simply return it to the shop without checking and consider the matter finished. I will listen to the explanation here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss how it should be handled rather than ending the matter by returning it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持ってきた時刻と、共用表示に気付いた時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell me when you brought it and when you noticed the shared-use label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨夜九時に取り、今日ここで表示に気付きました。その順番を伝えて、店へ説明する方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取った時刻と表示に気付いた時刻を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I took it at nine last night and noticed the label here today. I will explain that sequence and ask how to explain things to the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the time you took it separately from the time you noticed the label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その経緯と表示を担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that account and the label information on to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送するお荷物の内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what is in the parcel you want to send.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食品です。受取人が三週間留守だと、さっき分かりました。家へ送って待ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取人の長期不在と食品発送の相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Food. I just learned that the recipient will be away for three weeks. Could you send it to their home and have it wait for them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss sending food when the recipient will be away for a long time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食品の種類と保存条件を確認しましょう。受取人が対応できる送り先はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the type of food and its storage requirements. Is there an address where the recipient can receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 生ものなので、留守の玄関に置くつもりではありません。滞在先へ送れるか本人に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 玄関放置ではなく受取可能な送り先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is perishable, so I do not intend to leave it at the entrance while they are away. I would like to ask them whether I can send it to where they are staying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to confirm an address where it can be received, rather than leaving it at the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 滞在先が受け取れるかも確認してください。ご本人が了承する前に宛先を変えないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check whether the place where they are staying can accept it. Do not change the address before the recipient has agreed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。宿の住所は分かりますが、そこが荷物を受け取るかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 滞在先の荷物受付が未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I know the accommodation's address, but I do not know whether they accept parcels there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that parcel acceptance at the accommodation has not been confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の食品に対応する発送方法も、その後で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After that, we will also check a shipping method suitable for this food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。受取人と滞在先の両方が受け取れると分かるまで、今日は出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 双方の了承が出るまで発送しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not send it today until I know that both the recipient and the place they are staying can accept it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not ship it until both parties agree. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身の保存については、発送を待つ間もご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the storage of the contents yourself while you wait to ship them too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。保存条件を守り、受取可能な日時と住所が決まってから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存条件を守り受取日時と住所を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will follow the storage requirements and bring it back after the receiving date, time, and address are decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will follow the storage requirements and decide the receiving date, time, and address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備が整いましたら、内容と送り先に合う方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once everything is ready, we will explain a method suitable for the contents and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの切り替えについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to discuss switching cards?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。新しいカードが届いたので、古い方を切ろうと思いました。でも、どちらが使えるかまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新旧カードの利用状態が不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My new card arrived, so I was going to cut up the old one. However, I have not yet checked which one can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the usage status of the old and new cards. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お送りした案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you brought the instructions we sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。二枚が見た目で似ていて、古い方を正しく選べるか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 似た二枚と同封案内を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The two cards look similar, and I am worried I might not correctly identify the old one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the two similar cards and the enclosed instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示と案内を担当者が照合します。確認前にどちらも切らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will compare the details on the cards with the instructions. Please do not cut either card before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号の一部や有効期限で区別してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号表示や期限で対象を照合してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I would like you to distinguish them using part of the number or the expiration date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the relevant card to be identified using the displayed number or expiration date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用開始に必要な操作や、古いカードの扱いも一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check any steps required to start using the card and what to do with the old one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。届いたことだけで、古い方が停止して新しい方が使えるとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着と利用開始停止を別々に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not assume that the old one has been deactivated and the new one is usable simply because it arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check arrival, activation, and deactivation separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に、処分するカードと残すカードをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will tell you which card to dispose of and which to keep.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。対象を確かめ、使うカードを別にしまってから案内どおり処分します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 処分対象と残すカードを区別して扱うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will confirm the correct card, put the one I will use away separately, and then dispose of the other one as instructed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish the card to dispose of from the one to keep. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚と案内をお持ちのまま、担当窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take both cards and the instructions to the appropriate counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらはケース販売の商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: That product is sold by the case.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一本だけ欲しかったので、箱から抜きました。同じ飲み物なら一本の値段で買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱から一本を抜いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only wanted one, so I took one out of the box. Since it is the same drink, can I buy it at the price for one bottle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you took one bottle out of the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 単品用の売場は別です。いま取り出したものは、そのまま係員にお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Individual bottles are sold in a different area. Please hand the one you have taken out directly to a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。箱の中へ自分で戻さず、お渡しします。箱が少し破れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱の破れを申告し係員へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will hand it over rather than putting it back in the box myself. The box has torn a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report the torn box and hand the item to a staff member. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を確認します。単品をお求めでしたら、こちらの棚をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check its condition. If you would like an individual bottle, I can show you this shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。大きさも同じか見て、一人で飲める量を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単品で適した容量を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I would like to check whether it is the same size too and choose an amount I can drink on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to choose an individually sold bottle of a suitable size. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 単品の棚には別の容量もあります。ラベルの容量と価格をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The individual-bottle shelf also has other sizes. Please check the volume and price on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。箱の一本当たりの表示を、単品価格だと思わず見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ケース単価と単品価格を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will check again rather than assuming the per-bottle price shown on the case is the individual-bottle price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the case's unit price from the price for an individually sold bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この一本でよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この単品を一つ買います。取り出した商品と破れた箱は、係員の確認にお任せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単品一つを購入し箱の扱いを係員へ任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will buy one of this individually sold item. I will leave the staff member to check the item I took out and the torn box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy one individually sold item and leave the handling of the box to the staff member. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。単品の商品を会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will charge you for the individually sold item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆さんそろったら、入口から一緒に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Once everyone is together, we will go home together from the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人だけ、保護者が迎えに来る予定です。全員と帰る人数に入れたままでよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人の帰宅方法が変わったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: One child is due to be picked up by their guardian. Should I still include that child in the number going home with everyone else?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that one child's way of going home has changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 誰がどの方法で帰るか、責任者と確認しましょう。お迎えはもう到着していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us confirm with the person in charge who is going home in which way. Has the person picking the child up arrived yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。迎えが来る予定という連絡だけなので、引き渡したことにはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迎え予定と実際の引渡しを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. We have only received word that someone will come, so we cannot say the child has been handed over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the planned pickup from the actual handover. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その子は責任者と待ち、実際の引き渡しを確認して記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The child will wait with the person in charge, and we will confirm and record the actual handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私が先に人数表から消して、帰宅済みと書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引渡し前に帰宅済みと記録しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not remove the child from the headcount in advance and write that they have already gone home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not record the child as having gone home before the handover. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一緒に帰る人数と、迎え待ちの人数を分けて数えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please count those going home together separately from those waiting to be picked up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。一緒に帰るのは九人、迎え待ちは一人です。合計十人いることを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 九人の退出と一人の待機合計十人を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Nine are going home together, and one is waiting to be picked up. I will confirm that all ten are accounted for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm nine leaving and one waiting, for a total of ten. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後、責任者の指示でそれぞれ移動しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, let us have each group move as instructed by the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。九人の退出と一人の待機を区別し、引き渡しの記録は確認した人にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 責任者の指示と確認した人の記録に従うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will distinguish the nine leaving from the one waiting and ask the person who confirms the handover to record it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will follow the person in charge's instructions and have the handover recorded by the person who confirms it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その人数で責任者へ引き継ぎます。皆さんは入口でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass those numbers on to the person in charge. Everyone, please wait at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about a train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗れずに仕事へ遅れます。遅延を証明する紙をもらえば、会社へ説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗り遅れで遅延証明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I missed it and will be late for work. If I get a delay certificate, can I use it to explain things to my company?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a delay certificate after missing a train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用予定の列車は、実際に運行が遅れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was the train you intended to take actually running late?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が駅へ着いた時にはもう出ていました。列車が遅れたのかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発車後に到着し列車遅延は未確認だと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It had already left when I arrived at the station. I did not see whether the train was delayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you arrived after departure and have not confirmed whether the train was delayed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗り遅れたことと、列車の遅延は別です。この場面の予定列車は時刻どおりに発車しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Missing a train and a train being delayed are different things. The scheduled train in this situation departed on time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。列車の遅れとは会社へ言わず、自分が発車後に着いたと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社へ自分の到着遅れとして説明すると訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not tell my company that the train was delayed; I will say that I arrived after it had departed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct your explanation to the company to say that you yourself arrived late. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の列車の案内はできます。勤務先へ何時ごろ着くか、経路を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can give you information about the next train. Let us check the route to see about what time you can reach your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。次の到着予定を聞きたいです。駅から会社までの時間は自分で足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次便の駅到着予定を聞き徒歩時間は別に計算する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I would like to know the next arrival time. I will add the time from the station to my company myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask when the next train is expected to reach your station and calculate the walking time separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の便は目的の駅へ十時半着の予定です。実際の運行状況は表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next train is scheduled to reach your destination station at ten thirty. Please also check the display for actual operating conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十時半到着と徒歩の時間を分けて会社へ知らせます。遅延の紙は求めず、次の便へ乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遅延証明でなく次便の予定で連絡すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my company separately about the ten-thirty arrival and the walking time. I will take the next train without requesting a delay certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will contact your company using the next train's schedule rather than a delay certificate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが次の便の乗場案内です。急いで走らずお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the platform information for the next train. Please proceed without running, even if you are in a hurry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: オンライン相談用の端末を確認します。資料を表示できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let us check your device for the online consultation. Can you display the documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも画面全体を共有すると、家族からの通知も見えてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知まで共有される不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. However, if I share my entire screen, notifications from my family will be visible too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your concern that notifications will also be shared. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今はまだ共有していません。資料だけ開いた状態にしてから、共有方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are not sharing yet. Let us open just the document first and then check how to share it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 安心しました。資料が二つあるので、切り替える時にも他の画面が映らないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 資料切替時の共有範囲を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's a relief. I have two documents, so I am also worried that other screens might appear when I switch between them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the sharing area when switching documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切り替える前に共有を止める方法があります。試しに一つ目を映してみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can stop sharing before switching. Would you like to try displaying the first document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。もし別の画面が映ったら、その時点で止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試行中の停止を係員に依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If a different screen appears, please stop it at that point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff member to stop the trial if necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は一つ目だけ見えています。停止ボタンを押すと相手側には映りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Right now, only the first document is visible. If you press the stop button, the other party will no longer see it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 止められました。次の資料を開いてから、もう一度共有を始めればよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止と再開の順序を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I managed to stop it. So I should open the next document and then start sharing again, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the order of stopping and restarting sharing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。相談中も、共有を再開する前に相手へ一言お伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. During the consultation too, please say something to the other party before restarting sharing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「次の資料に替えます」と伝えて止め、内容を確認してから再開します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談相手への切替の伝え方を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say, 'I am switching to the next document,' stop sharing, check the contents, and then restart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain how you will tell the other person in the consultation that you are switching documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その手順で結構です。相談の接続時にも一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: That procedure is fine. We will also check it together when connecting for the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紹介状をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will take your referral letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒です。別の病院へも相談するかもしれないので、内容を手元に残したいのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介状の内容を手元に残したい理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is in this envelope. I may also consult another hospital, so I would like to keep a copy of its contents for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you would like to keep the contents of the referral letter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身では開けていないのですね。控えが必要な理由を診療担当へ伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not opened it yourself, correct? Let us explain to the clinical staff why you need a copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。受付で封を開けて写真を撮るつもりでしたが、ここでお願いしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封を開けて撮影する前に依頼先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I was going to open the envelope at reception and take a photo. May I request that here instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whom to request a copy from before opening the envelope and photographing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付では内容の複写を判断できません。原本をお預かりしたうえで、担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception cannot decide whether the contents may be copied. We will take the original and check with the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、原本は渡します。後でどこへ相談すればよいか分かるようにしてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原本を渡し控えの相談を引き継ぐよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case, I will give you the original. I would like to know where I should ask about this later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand over the original and ask for your request about a copy to be passed on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えの相談をしたことを記録します。お名前と紹介元を照合しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that you asked about a copy. Let me check your name and the referring institution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。紹介元の診察券もありますが、これも一緒に預けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紹介元の診察券の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name is here. I also have the referring hospital's patient card. Should I leave that with you too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check how the referring hospital's patient card will be handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察券は確認だけでお返しします。紹介状の控えについては診察時に改めてお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will only check the patient card and return it. Please ask again about a copy of the referral letter during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。診察券を受け取り、控えの相談が記録されたことを診察で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却物と診察時に尋ねる事項をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will collect my patient card and confirm during the consultation that my request about a copy has been recorded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize what will be returned and what you should ask during the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録しました。原本はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12230-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have recorded it. We will keep the original here.
